name: Learning Index
body:
> Index · 2026-10-22

# Summary
Courses and lesson takeaways Kim has studied for TAG work. Course notes link every lesson; each lesson note ends with "How this applies to TAG clients".

# Courses
- [AI SEO Masterclass](lib:brain-ai-seo-masterclass): Local Rank Academy, 14 lessons (traditional SEO, GEO/AI citations, local SEO in the AI era, content, tools, case studies, SOPs). Saved Oct 8, 2026.
- [Local SEO Lesson](lib:brain-local-seo-lesson): Local Rank Academy Local SEO Masterclass, 21 lessons (rank-and-rent track plus Modules 1 to 16). Saved Oct 8, 2026.
- [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course): 4 modules, 17 lessons on ranking the map pack (rank map, three-step method, Core 30) plus client acquisition and pricing. Transcribed from video (see [Video Notes Project](lib:brain-video-notes-project)).

# Takeaways
- [Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-08](lib:brain-lesson-takeaways-2026-10-08)
- [Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-09](lib:brain-lesson-takeaways-2026-10-09)

# Reading guide
- Policy-safe fundamentals: Local SEO Lesson Modules 1 to 16 and AI SEO Masterclass Modules 1, 2, 5 and 8.
- Read with caution: rank-and-rent lessons and AI SEO Modules 3, 6 and 7 teach tactics (PBNs, fake or incentivized reviews, account farming, paid direction traffic) that are not used on TAG clients.
